concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-verification-overview-data-review-process]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured legal-entity periodic-review guide for deadline/capability webhooks, onboarding-v3/v4 proactive requests and user confirmation plus error resolution; request/confirmation is not KYC approval.
warnings: During an active deadline, verificationStatus can be invalid while previously allowed capabilities remain allowed; disallow follows unresolved deadline.
A 204 proactive-request response and dataReviewedAt confirmation time do not prove review finalization or successful verification.
